    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.head: Node[K, V] = Node.__new__(Node)  # sentinel
        self.tail: Node[K, V] = Node.__new__(Node)  # sentinel
        self.head.prev = None
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head
        self.tail.next = None
        self._size: int = 0

    @property
    def size(self) -> int:
        return self._size

    def add_to_front(self, node: Node[K, V]) -> None:
        """Insert node right after the head sentinel (MRU position)."""
        node.prev = self.head
        node.next = self.head.next
        self.head.next.prev = node
